Why our blockchain

Protect the data. Prove the execution.

Hyper-ABS protects sensitive information from unnecessary data exposure before inference. Hyper-0x, Buckleson’s in-house blockchain, creates tamper-evident execution records that support verification, audit, and settlement.

Hyper-0x records what happened around AI execution; it does not claim that an AI answer is true.
